name: Plugin Manager
author: Fross
description: Manage installed Omarchy plugins: enable/disable, update, install from git, and remove third-party plugins

barWidget.description: Enable/disable, update, install, and remove plugins

schema.label: Review plugins before installing
schema.description: Before an install runs, clone the repository into a throwaway directory and ask your default Omarchy coding agent (omarchy default agent) for a security review — no tools, no session, only the bundled source as input. Supported today: Claude Code, Codex, opencode. Any other default agent shows why a review isn't available and offers Install without review, exactly like a failed review would.

schema.label: Review budget (USD, Claude Code only)
schema.description: Passed to the reviewer as a spend cap for a single review. Only enforced when the default agent is Claude Code.
